p80d329.observed: docs/api.md documents PUT /tickets/:id/assignee (400/404/409, trimming, 64-character limit, refusal of the em dash name), the assignee ticket field, the assignee filter (exact, case-sensitive, assignee= or bare assignee for unassigned, unchecked values answer 200 empty, repeated filters must match every value), the audit actions ticket.assigned and ticket.unassigned, and the ticket.assigned notification; docs/operations.md describes the notification line, its type, its 'to' (the agent name) and its per-assignment key; README describes the ASSIGNEE column, the em dash for unassigned in list and show and the fifth raw field; CHANGELOG has a 1.5.0 section and package.json is 1.5.0; decision 0009 added and indexed. Checked against the running product: 200 with assignee, 409 on resolved, '' and 65 chars 400, '—' 400 with the documented message, ?assignee=<65 chars> 200 empty, ?status=open&status=closed lists nothing, audit actions ticket.assigned/ticket.unassigned, outbox type ticket.assigned to 'Dana Lee' with key ticket.assigned:T-0001:2, list shows ASSIGNEE with '—' for unassigned, list --raw has a fifth field empty when unassigned, show prints the assignee; all as documented.

pb56fe2.observed: docs/api.md documents the endpoint (400/404/409, 1-64 code points), the assignee field, the filter (assignee= for unassigned) and the audit actions ticket.assigned/ticket.unassigned, and says only that 'the worker sends each new assignee an assignment notification' without naming the type or recipient; docs/operations.md is unchanged from 1.4.0 (its notifications section still lists only received and resolved); README describes the assignee column, the em dash for unassigned and the fifth raw field; decision 0009 added and indexed. No release record: CHANGELOG.md is byte-identical to base (no new section) and package.json version is still 1.4.0. Running the product: behaviour matches what is documented (200 with assignee, 409 on resolved, raw fifth field empty when unassigned, outbox type ticket.assigned), but README's 'an em dash indicates an unassigned ticket' is not reliable: PUT {"assignee":"—"} answers 200 and stores '—', which list and show then display exactly like an unassigned ticket.

p21e512.observed: docs/api.md documents the endpoint (body must be valid UTF-8 and hold only assignee, 1-64 UTF-16 code units, control characters refused, 409 for resolved/closed even when the value is unchanged, 500 on a failed save), the assignee field, the filter (exact incl. case and spaces, assignee= for unassigned, repeated parameter uses its first value, invalid nonempty assignee values return invalid), the single audit action ticket.assigned covering set and clear, and the notification to the incoming agent; docs/operations.md covers old data files, rollback, the notification and its per-assignment key; README describes the quoted-name / 'unassigned' ASSIGNEE column, show, and that list --raw keeps four columns; CHANGELOG has 1.5.0, 1.5.1 and 1.5.2 sections and package.json is 1.5.2; decision 0009 added and indexed. Checked against the running product: invalid UTF-8 PUT 400 'request body is not valid UTF-8', ?assignee=<65 chars> 400 invalid, ?status=open&status=closed uses the first value, unassign recorded as ticket.assigned {from:'Dana Lee',to:null}, outbox ticket.assigned to 'Dana Lee', list shows "Dana Lee" / unassigned, list --raw has four fields, show prints the assignee and distinguishes "null" from null; all as documented.
